content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Hyderabad Project Associate II (Accountant) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 10-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad (IIT Hyderabad) for its CLEANZ Department project requirements.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post announced in this notification is Project Associate II (Accountant) under a temporary engagement structure.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Associate II (Accountant) position in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess any Bachelor's degree from a recognised university or institution along with relevant accounting experience.

faq.question: Q5. What experience is required for this role?
faq.answer: Applicants must have a minimum of 1 year of relevant experience in accounting, preferably in project or institutional accounts, alongside advanced MS Excel skills.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years, with age relaxations applicable as per Government of India and IIT Hyderabad guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary ranging between ₹ 35,000 and ₹ 45,000 per month.

faq.question: Q8. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 10-10-2026. Candidates should ensure timely submission before the deadline.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to submit their applications along with an updated CV and self-attested certificates via email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a written test, a skill test, and/or a personal interview conducted by IIT Hyderabad.
